column1: # Game profile of Dead Cells (Switch, update 1.25.0 = v3014656). Plays on the Mac
# Motion Twin's game on Heaps and HashLink (HL/C compiled into main), SDK 13.3.5, with its own NVN driver (nx.nvn.NvnDriver). The shaders are in res1.pak: shaders.cache.nx holds each program's
# GLSL and its GLSLC output in base64 (shader_split.py heaps_shaders). main imports GLSLC (subsdk0), but the runs so far compiled nothing with it

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = GLSLC, which main imports)
# The NPDM declares no system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false and nninitStartup sets a heap: 3.06 GB of the hardware pool, in a 3.25 GB heap region of the 4 GB block
